name: Adam Kirtley
title: Senior media trainer and BBC broadcast journalist
bio_short: Senior media trainer and BBC broadcast journalist with more than 25 years' experience. Presents on BBC Radio 4 and Five Live. Trains CEOs and senior executives in media skills, crisis media and presentation in the Middle East and Europe.
bio: Adam is a senior media trainer and broadcast journalist with more than 25 years' BBC experience. He presents on BBC Radio 4, BBC Radio 5 Live, BBC Radio 2, the BBC World Service and the BBC News Channel, and is a regular voice across BBC Radio Scotland, Wales, Ulster and the BBC's 40 regional stations. His journalism career has included covering business, finance and consumer news across the British and global airwaves, and he has also worked for Times Radio.  As a media and crisis communication trainer, Adam has worked extensively across the Middle East, Europe and Africa through his consultancy Adam Kirtley Media. His clients include senior executives at major energy companies, banks, mining companies, European government agencies and international courts. Notable engagements include crisis media training for judges at a major European court, ongoing media and presentation skills training for a major Middle Eastern energy company, and crisis training for the Seychelles government during a live banking and telecoms crisis.  At ISOC, Adam delivers media training, crisis media training and presentation skills programmes for senior executives and spokespeople. His approach combines the forensic questioning skills of a working BBC journalist with a constructive, practical coaching style. His continued work as an active BBC journalist means his training reflects the current media landscape. Adam is based in the UK and trains in English.
